en.title: Jingdezhen, China: Porcelain City & 2026 World Heritage Site
en.headline: Jingdezhen: What the 2026 World Heritage Listing Covers, What to See and How Long to Stay
en.description: Jingdezhen in Jiangxi has made porcelain for a thousand years and joined the World Heritage List in July 2026. What to see, prices, hours and how many days.
en.heroAlt: An old brick wood-fired kiln under a timber shed in Jingdezhen, with stacked firewood and clay saggers beside it

zh.title: 景德镇攻略：2026 新晋世界遗产，御窑、古窑和陶溪川怎么逛
zh.headline: 景德镇：2026 年列入世界遗产的是什么、看什么、住几晚
zh.description: 江西景德镇烧了一千年瓷器，2026 年 7 月列入世界遗产。看什么、门票和开放时间、哪天闭馆、住几晚。
zh.heroAlt: 景德镇木棚下的一座砖砌老柴窑，旁边码着木柴和匣钵
